mutant.description: Two mutants, each removing one step of my own method and re-running it, to test whether that step is load-bearing or decorative. Mutant 1 removes cohort-matching from the ETF delta; mutant 2 removes name-normalization from the Cottonwood 18-strategy reconciliation.
mutant.expected: Mutant 1 should inflate the ETF growth figure by counting PFDE/PFOE's coverage onset as growth. Mutant 2 should manufacture false 'missing strategy' findings for roster names that differ cosmetically from Andrew's list.
mutant.observed: MUTANT 1 FIRED: mutated (no cohort match) 754,683,842.00 - 380,090,654.30 = +374,593,187.70 (+98.55%) vs correct (cohort-matched) 496,914,800.00 - 380,090,654.30 = +116,824,145.70 (+30.74%). Divergence $257,769,042.00, the two differ by 2.2x. MUTANT 2 FIRED, and harder than predicted: exact-string-only matching reports 4 of the 18 as on-list-not-found -- 'Anna *9238', 'Moderate Income Portfolio', 'Opal - Beecherl Legg', 'Opal - Income' -- all four of which are present on the roster. Correct normalized run reports EMPTY. I predicted 1-2 and measured 4; the deliverable was corrected to the measured figure.
